model.name: anthropic/claude-sonnet-5
model.about: Anthropic: Claude Sonnet 5, through OpenRouter at $2 in and $10 out per million tokens.

answers.sql: SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY txn_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customer_cnt FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.IS_MTH_END = TRUE AND d.MTH_NBR = 8 AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT dc.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG dc ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = dc.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dc.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT d.CAL_DT AS bus_dt, f.CCY_CD1 AS currency, AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY d.CAL_DT, f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY d.CAL_DT, f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT f.MKT_ID AS market, SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY f.MKT_ID ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1, COUNT(*) AS ACCOUNTS_OPENED
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT br.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1 GROUP BY br.CTY_NM ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_nbr, COUNT(*) AS dispute_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;
SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_2025_txn
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
);
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_declined FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name, COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY escalated_complaint_count DESC;
SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.LN_ID) AS loans_90dpd
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON r.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND r.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT d.LN_ID, d.LN_PRD_K, d.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.LN_ID ORDER BY dt.CAL_DT DESC) AS rn
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       SUM(l.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM latest l
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON l.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
WHERE l.rn = 1
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY p.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_customers_with_crossborder_wire_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH branch_txn AS (
  SELECT b.RGN_CD1 AS region_cd, b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY b.RGN_CD1, b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT region_cd, branch_name, atm_txn_cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_cd ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC) AS rn
  FROM branch_txn
)
SELECT region_cd, branch_name, atm_txn_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_cd;

SELECT c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id, SUM(w.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.BUS_ID ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.CUST_K) AS cust_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dw ON w.BUS_DT_K = dw.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT da ON a.BUS_DT_K = da.DT_K
WHERE dw.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND da.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS transfer_year, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;
SELECT DISTINCT DSPLY_NM AS branch_name FROM bank_dwh.D_BR;

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.IS_WKND) AS weekend_txn_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT d.IS_WKND) AS weekday_txn_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH jun AS (
  SELECT f.ACCT_K, f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS bal_jun
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'
),
dec AS (
  SELECT f.ACCT_K, f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS bal_dec
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts_with_decline_over_10pct
FROM jun
JOIN dec ON jun.ACCT_K = dec.ACCT_K
WHERE jun.bal_jun > 0
  AND dec.bal_dec < jun.bal_jun * 0.9;

WITH curr AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, CUST_SGMNT_CD1, VRSN_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
),
prev AS (
  SELECT c.BUS_ID, p.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM curr c
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
    WHERE d.BUS_ID = c.BUS_ID AND d.VRSN_NBR < c.VRSN_NBR
    ORDER BY d.VRSN_NBR DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) p ON TRUE
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_segment_change
FROM curr c
JOIN prev p ON c.BUS_ID = p.BUS_ID
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS DISTINCT FROM p.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cust_cnt
FROM (
  SELECT t.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY t.CUST_K
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.QTR_NBR) = 4
) sub;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS cust_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt2 ON w.BUS_DT_K = dt2.DT_K
    WHERE w.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
      AND dt2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  );

WITH d20240630 AS (
  SELECT r.ACCT_K, r.DYS_PST_DUE
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON r.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2024-06-30'
),
d20250630 AS (
  SELECT r.ACCT_K, r.DYS_PST_DUE
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON r.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.ACCT_K) AS loan_count
FROM d20240630 a
JOIN d20250630 b ON a.ACCT_K = b.ACCT_K
WHERE a.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  AND b.DYS_PST_DUE > 30;

SELECT t.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.ORGNL_AMT) AS median_amount FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY t.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY t.CCY_CD1;

WITH monthly_last_dt AS (SELECT MTH_NBR, MAX(CAL_DT) AS last_dt FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY MTH_NBR) SELECT m.MTH_NBR, SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance FROM monthly_last_dt m JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.CAL_DT = m.last_dt AND d.MTH_NBR = m.MTH_NBR AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K GROUP BY m.MTH_NBR ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30' AND (EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR EFF_TO_DT > DATE '2023-06-30') GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH cust_totals AS (
  SELECT c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS seg_cd, c.BUS_ID AS cust_bus_id, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, c.BUS_ID
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT seg_cd, cust_bus_id, total_amt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seg_cd ORDER BY total_amt DESC) AS rn
  FROM cust_totals
)
SELECT seg_cd, cust_bus_id, total_amt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY seg_cd, total_amt DESC;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, COUNT(*) AS transfer_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_2025_transfers FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY pct_of_2025_transfers DESC;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_nbr, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR) AS running_total FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN t.ORGNL_AMT ELSE t.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT END) AS total_eur_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx ON fx.BUS_DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K AND fx.CCY_CD1 = t.ORGNL_CCY_CD1
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS mth,
         COUNT(*) AS total_auths,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.AUTH_RSLT_CD1 = 'DECLINED') AS declined_auths
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT mth AS month_number,
       ROUND(100.0 * declined_auths / NULLIF(total_auths,0), 2) AS declined_share_pct
FROM monthly
ORDER BY declined_share_pct DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.CCY_CD1 AS currency, SUM(t.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY t.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_volume DESC;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY txn_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE AND d.CAL_DT = (SELECT MAX(d2.CAL_DT) FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d2 WHERE d2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d2.MTH_NBR = 8);

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT d.CAL_DT AS bus_date, f.CCY_CD1 AS currency, AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY d.CAL_DT, f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY d.CAL_DT, f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT f.MKT_ID, SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_mkt_val
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.MKT_ID
ORDER BY total_mkt_val DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1, COUNT(*) AS ACCOUNTS_OPENED
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
 AND OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
 AND OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT br.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.QTR_NBR = 1 GROUP BY br.CTY_NM ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_nbr, COUNT(*) AS dispute_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;
SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
);
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_declined FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT dcc.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name, COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG dcc ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = dcc.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dcc.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaint_count DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.LN_ID) AS loans_90dpd
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON r.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND r.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name, SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON f.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY p.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_customers_cross_border_wire_2025 FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME' AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH branch_txn AS (
  SELECT b.RGN_CD1 AS region_cd, b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY b.RGN_CD1, b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT region_cd, branch_name, atm_txn_cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_cd ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC) AS rn
  FROM branch_txn
)
SELECT region_cd, branch_name, atm_txn_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_cd;

SELECT c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.BUS_ID ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT t.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, SUM(t.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY t.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY t.CCY_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.CUST_K) AS cust_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dw ON w.BUS_DT_K = dw.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT da ON a.BUS_DT_K = da.DT_K WHERE dw.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND da.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;
SELECT DISPLY_NM AS branch_name FROM bank_dwh.D_BR;

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.IS_WKND) AS weekend_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT d.IS_WKND) AS weekday_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH b1 AS (SELECT f.ACCT_K, f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS bal_jun FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'), b2 AS (SELECT f.ACCT_K, f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS bal_dec FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31') SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM b1 JOIN b2 ON b1.ACCT_K = b2.ACCT_K WHERE b1.bal_jun > 0 AND b2.bal_dec < b1.bal_jun * 0.9;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, CUST_SGMNT_CD1, VRSN_NBR, IS_CURR,
         LAG(CUST_SGMNT_CD1) OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR) AS prev_sgmnt
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_segment_change
FROM ranked
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND prev_sgmnt IS NOT NULL
  AND CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS DISTINCT FROM prev_sgmnt;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cust_cnt FROM (SELECT t.CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY t.CUST_K HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.QTR_NBR) = 4) sub;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS cust_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.CUST_K NOT IN (
    SELECT w.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt2 ON w.BUS_DT_K = dt2.DT_K
    WHERE dt2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  );

WITH d20240630 AS (
  SELECT r.ACCT_K, r.DYS_PST_DUE,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.ACCT_K ORDER BY r.BUS_DT_K DESC) AS rn
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON r.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2024-06-30'
),
d20250630 AS (
  SELECT r.ACCT_K, r.DYS_PST_DUE,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.ACCT_K ORDER BY r.BUS_DT_K DESC) AS rn
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON r.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM d20240630 a
JOIN d20250630 b ON a.ACCT_K = b.ACCT_K
WHERE a.rn = 1 AND b.rn = 1
  AND a.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  AND b.DYS_PST_DUE > 30;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.ORGNL_AMT) AS median_amount FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

WITH mth_last_dt AS (
  SELECT MTH_NBR, MAX(CAL_DT) AS LAST_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY MTH_NBR
)
SELECT d.MTH_NBR, SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS TOTAL_CLOSING_BAL
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN mth_last_dt m ON d.MTH_NBR = m.MTH_NBR AND d.CAL_DT = m.LAST_DT
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
  AND (EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR EFF_TO_DT > DATE '2023-06-30')
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH wire_totals AS (
  SELECT
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_cd,
    c.BUS_ID AS cust_bus_id,
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_amt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  GROUP BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, c.BUS_ID
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    segment_cd,
    cust_bus_id,
    total_wire_amt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment_cd ORDER BY total_wire_amt DESC) AS rn
  FROM wire_totals
)
SELECT segment_cd, cust_bus_id, total_wire_amt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment_cd, total_wire_amt DESC;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, COUNT(*) AS transfer_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_2025_transfers FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY pct_of_2025_transfers DESC;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_nbr, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR) AS running_total FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN t.ORGNL_AMT ELSE t.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT END) AS total_eur_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx ON fx.CCY_K = t.CCY_K AND fx.BUS_DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_nbr, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.AUTH_RSLT_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_share_pct FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR ORDER BY declined_share_pct DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_volume DESC;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY txn_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_DT = (SELECT MAX(CAL_DT) FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND MTH_NBR = 8) AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT dc.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(*) AS complaint_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG dc ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = dc.CMPLT_CTG_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY dc.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY complaint_cnt DESC;

SELECT d.CAL_DT AS bus_date, f.CCY_CD1 AS currency, AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY d.CAL_DT, f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY d.CAL_DT, f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT f.MKT_ID, SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_mkt_val, COUNT(*) AS row_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY f.MKT_ID ORDER BY total_mkt_val DESC;
SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1, COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025 GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1 ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT br.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1 GROUP BY br.CTY_NM ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';
SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_nbr, COUNT(*) AS dispute_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;
SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
);
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_declined FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name, COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaint_cnt DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.ACCT_K) AS loans_90dpd
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name, SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON f.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY p.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_customers_crossborder_wire_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH br_txn AS (SELECT b.RGN_CD1 AS region_code, b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY b.RGN_CD1, b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM), ranked AS (SELECT region_code, BR_K, branch_name, atm_txn_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC) AS rn FROM br_txn) SELECT region_code, branch_name, atm_txn_cnt FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT c.BUS_ID, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_amt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.BUS_ID ORDER BY total_wire_amt DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.CUST_K) AS customer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dw ON w.BUS_DT_K = dw.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT da ON a.BUS_DT_K = da.DT_K
WHERE dw.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND da.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;
SELECT DSPLY_NM AS branch_name FROM bank_dwh.D_BR;

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.IS_WKND) AS weekend_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT d.IS_WKND) AS weekday_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH jun AS (SELECT f.ACCT_K, f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS bal_jun FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'), dec AS (SELECT f.ACCT_K, f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS bal_dec FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31') SELECT COUNT(*) AS acct_count FROM jun JOIN dec ON jun.ACCT_K = dec.ACCT_K WHERE jun.bal_jun > 0 AND dec.bal_dec < jun.bal_jun * 0.9;

WITH curr AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS curr_sgmnt, VRSN_NBR AS curr_vrsn
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
),
prev AS (
  SELECT d.BUS_ID, d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS prev_sgmnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.BUS_ID ORDER BY d.VRSN_NBR DESC) AS rn
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
  JOIN curr c ON c.BUS_ID = d.BUS_ID AND d.VRSN_NBR < c.curr_vrsn
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_segment_change
FROM curr
JOIN prev ON prev.BUS_ID = curr.BUS_ID AND prev.rn = 1
WHERE prev.prev_sgmnt IS DISTINCT FROM curr.curr_sgmnt;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cust_cnt
FROM (
  SELECT t.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY t.CUST_K
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.QTR_NBR) = 4
) sub;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS cust_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
AND d.CUST_K NOT IN (
  SELECT w.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt2 ON w.BUS_DT_K = dt2.DT_K
  WHERE dt2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
);

WITH d20240630 AS (
  SELECT r.ACCT_K, r.DYS_PST_DUE
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON r.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2024-06-30'
),
d20250630 AS (
  SELECT r.ACCT_K, r.DYS_PST_DUE
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON r.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM d20240630 a
JOIN d20250630 b ON a.ACCT_K = b.ACCT_K
WHERE a.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  AND b.DYS_PST_DUE > 30;

SELECT CCY_CD1, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORGNL_AMT) AS median_amount FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY CCY_CD1 ORDER BY CCY_CD1;

WITH mth_max AS (
  SELECT MTH_NBR, MAX(CAL_DT) AS last_dt
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY MTH_NBR
)
SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_nbr,
       SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN mth_max m ON d.MTH_NBR = m.MTH_NBR AND d.CAL_DT = m.last_dt
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
  AND (EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR EFF_TO_DT > DATE '2023-06-30')
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH cust_totals AS (
  SELECT c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS seg_cd, c.BUS_ID AS cust_bus_id, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, c.BUS_ID
), ranked AS (
  SELECT seg_cd, cust_bus_id, total_amt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seg_cd ORDER BY total_amt DESC) AS rn
  FROM cust_totals
)
SELECT seg_cd, cust_bus_id, total_amt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY seg_cd, total_amt DESC;

SELECT t.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, COUNT(*) AS transfer_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_2025_total FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY t.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY pct_of_2025_total DESC;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_nbr, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR) AS running_total FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN t.ORGNL_AMT ELSE t.ORGNL_AMT / r.MID_RT END) AS total_eur_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D r ON r.CCY_K = t.CCY_K AND r.BUS_DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.AUTH_RSLT_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS decline_share_pct FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR ORDER BY decline_share_pct DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS ccy_code, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_volume FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 ORDER BY total_wire_volume DESC;
